notes: INSIDE half of the Human Concord Railgun: a bank of four tall capacitors that fill with blue-white charge from the bottom (frame 5 = all four bright, strip green), thick power coupling, hatch. fire: the bank flashes white and drops dark. damaged: one capacitor cracked and weeping, two cells dead; disabled: the bank dark, a capacitor split. Barrel layer human_concord_railgun_barrel: two long parallel rails with blue field coils and a bright gap between them; fire: a blue-white flash and arc at the muzzle.
